title: Moment 5: Planning a trip, One conversation, one itinerary
intro: A short made-up storyboard from endgame.life. Lena plans a week by the sea without opening ten tabs. Nothing here is real and nothing is sent.

steps.say: Made-up example, nothing is sent. Lena says what she wants: a quiet week by the sea in April, under her budget.
The calendar check finds April 12 to 19 free.
A draft itinerary appears: train out, small inn, three walks, one day of nothing.
Only after Lena says yes are any bookings made.
